svg.aria-label: Twelve covers arrive one after another, each playing its motion: the sun lifts, ink lands in register, a cairn stacks itself.
svg.title: Twelve covers arrive one after another, each playing its motion: the sun lifts, ink lands in register, a cairn stacks itself.

"Avenir Next", -apple-system, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Built-in covers in colorways, each with its own one-shot motion. Or have Claude draw an original.
